notes: CEILING: the toilet render model has a 2.344 m ceiling (6 cm below the owner's 2.40 m; the bathroom renders give 2.41 and the work room 2.61). Heights in this file are in the render-model scale. To adopt 2.40, keep absolute heights of fixtures (basin, toilet, flush plate, machines) and stretch only the ceiling-hung items (cabinet top panel, concealer top panel, mirror top), or scale every y by 2.40/2.344 = 1.024.

Cameras p01, p02 and p04 are outside the usable space (p01 0.38 m beyond the top wall, p02 1.13 m beyond the left wall, p04 inside the machine concealer); p03 is inside. Use near_clip_m or hide the wall/unit behind the camera.

Focal length: all four share f = 1965 px (vfov = hfov = 66.2 deg, the same lens as the work-room renders). p01 alone prefers a much longer lens if its focal length is freed (about 3100-3700 px) but then disagrees with its own vanishing points; with the shared value its edge rms is 1.3 px, the others 0.14-0.23 px.

There is no window in the toilet. The plan's door p5-B on the left wall is confirmed (casing top 2.12, opening head 2.03). In p01 the door's far casing edge sits about 12 cm closer to the concealer than the plan says; the plan position was kept.

The concealer's machine column is x 0.022-0.624 (plan line at 0.62, confirmed in p01 and p03) and the open shelf column x 0.624-0.868; machine heights assume the fronts at z 1.785 (+-1 cm per 3 cm of depth error).
The toilet lid height is uncertain (0.45-0.50 depending on the assumed depth of its top edge); use a standard seat height of about 0.42 m.
Not determined: the door's hinge and handle side, the bowl underside, the internal layout of the closed base under the shelf column, the exact ceiling-disc model.
Colours are rendered pixel values; see colours._how_to_read.
